Send messages (SMS / MMS / WhatsApp) — channel-split surface

Usage:
  plivo messaging [command]

Aliases:
  messaging, message, msg, sms

Available Commands:
  get         Get a message by UUID (works for SMS, MMS, and WhatsApp)
  mms         MMS — multimedia messages (US/Canada)
  sms         SMS — A2P / P2P short-message-service (incl. 10DLC, powerpacks, toll-free)
  whatsapp    WhatsApp — Plivo's WhatsApp Business API surface

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for messaging

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain            explain what the command will do before executing
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts

Use "plivo messaging [command] --help" for more information about a command.
